subject: Index rehydration / data-contracts and rerank dry-run trajectory
messages:
From: Li Wei <li.wei@atlassearch.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@atlassearch.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: index seeding + rerank validation dry run

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick sync this morning. We chatted internally and want to validate the following before we schedule any heavy backfills:

- Confirm the minimal index schema we need for initial rerank tests (fields + vector dims).
- A short dry-run (2k docs) to exercise prefix caching + KV behavior.
- A deterministic rerank evaluation: we can provide ~100 prompt pairs for smoke testing.

Attached a sample index_schema_sample.csv and a redline to the contract (atlas_contract_v2.pdf) — legal flagged retention terms we may want to discuss.

Can you propose an execution window next week and an internal owner for the backfill?

Best,
Li
Senior Search Engineer
AtlasSearch
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Li Wei <li.wei@atlassearch.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: index seeding + rerank validation dry run

Thanks Li — quick read looks great. High level proposal attached below; Ive looped Ben (CS lead) and Marissa (Implementation PM) to scope the dry-run.

Proposal (short):
- Owner: Ben Carter (CS) executes the dry-run with Atlas infra contacts.
- Window: 2027-04-06 02:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic) for the 2k doc ingest + smoke rerank.
- Vector DB: start with the existing managed vectorstore (v1) using 1536-d vectors, TTL disabled for dry-run. Well instrument token-level latencies.
- Backfill pattern: batch size 250, concurrent workers 4, 1-min gap between batches for KV warming.
- Rerank evals: well run the 100 prompt pairs; collect NDCG@10 and A/B qualitative checks.

Next steps: Ben to draft a short runbook with rollback steps; Marissa to confirm contract retention flags with legal.

- Soojin
Product Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Li Wei <li.wei@atlassearch.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: index seeding + rerank validation dry run

Appreciate the context — Ill own the execution. A few operational notes and questions so we can finalize the runbook:

Operational outline:
- Pre-checks (day -2): schema validation; sample vector ingest (50 docs); acceptance on recall baseline.
- Dry-run (day 0): 2,000 docs via S3 -> Redwood ingest job; enable continuous batching on the runner; monitoring hooks (token latency, batch latency, error rates).
- Post-checks (day +1): run rerank eval set, collect metrics and flagged examples.

Questions for Atlas:
1) Do you have an IP allowlist or VPC peering readiness for our ingest worker IPs?
2) Are there any PII columns we need to redact before seeding?
3) Can you confirm the canonical doc id mapping so we can test rehydration determinism?

Ill draft the runbook (including a dry-run rollback: immediately stop ingest, drop newly created index namespace, and point queries back to v0). Expect a first pass by EOD 4/2.

- Ben
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Li Wei <li.wei@atlassearch.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T16:57:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: index seeding + rerank validation dry run

Adding the implementation checklist and a few attachments (see attached rerank_eval_prompts.md). Highlights:

- Acceptance criteria: successful ingest of 2k docs within 4 hours; no Redis/KV eviction >5% during window; stable p50 token latency (<60ms).
- Canaries: we will run a 100-doc canary first (10:30 UTC) and validate rerank outputs against baseline. If canary passes, escalate to full 2k.
- Vector DB considerations:
  * Use persistent shard layout 4/8 depending on storage footprint.
  * Quantization: do NOT apply Q4 during dry-run; run in float32 path so we can profile token costs accurately.
  * Similarity thresholding: start at cosine >= 0.78 for candidate generation, then reranker to reorder top 50.
- Data-contracts: legal redlines noted; retention conversation scheduled for 4/5.

Attachments: index_schema_sample.csv, rerank_eval_prompts.md

Action items:
- Ben: post runbook draft (due 4/2 EOD) + ops slack channel.
- Soojin: confirm monitoring hooks we need and add eval metrics dashboard.
- Li: confirm IP allowlist + canonical id mapping.

-Marissa
Implementation PM, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Planning: index seeding + rerank validation dry run

- PII: none of the seeded docs contain user PII; will still strip email headers and user IDs.
- Prefers 2027-04-06 02:00 UTC window as proposed.
- Legal: well review the retention redlines and get back by 4/5.

Well upload final sample CSV and the prompt pairs to the shared Drive tonight.

—Carlos

- Ive set the ingest worker to 4 concurrent processes with a 30s jitter to spread load.
- Metrics to capture: ingest throughput, batch latency histogram, kv-cache hit rate, rerank NDCG@10 delta, top-5 discordant examples.
- Rollback checklist included: index snapshot + alias switch back.

Ill create the #atlas-dryrun slack channel and invite the team. If Marissa confirms legal timeline on 4/5 were green.
